details:
This update for gh fixes the following issues:

Changes in gh:

- Update to version 2.102.0, fixing four security issues
  (GHSA-39wj-f2f4-978v, GHSA-4mq3-hpgx-9cx8, GHSA-qcwj-mr2r-2cx7,
  GHSA-wjmr-j3rp-mh2g):

  * gh release/run/attestation download and repo read-file --output
    could write to an unintended file through symbolic links
  * gh attestation verify compared --source-ref case-insensitively
  * gh attestation verify matched --signer-workflow only by prefix
  * gh skill search could inject options into gh skill install
  * Copy auth codes to the clipboard by default (gh config set
    clipboard disabled to opt out)
  * Remove the gh repo garden command and the multi-account migration
  * Use API SSH URLs for repository clones
  * Validate repository names during interactive creation
  * Fix remote branch deletion on owner case mismatch
  * Propagate the gh path to extensions
  * Allow ghu_ tokens to attach files
  * Allow gh repo set-default --unset without an argument
  * Bump go-gh to 2.16.1, golang.org/x/crypto to 0.57.0,
    github.com/klauspost/compress to 1.20.1 and Go to 1.27.1
- Update golang.org/x/net to 0.60.0 to fix
  excessive CPU consumption on repeated HTTP/2 initial window
  changes (CVE-2026-78669, bsc#1285291).
- Require golang(API) >= 1.27 as upstream moved to Go 1.27.
- Not affected, vendored dependencies are above the fixed version:
  * CVE-2026-84445 (bsc#1278962): grpc is 1.83.2, fixed in 1.83.2
  * CVE-2026-84304 (bsc#1279208), CVE-2026-84303 (bsc#1279310):
    grpc is 1.83.2, fixed in 1.83.1
  * CVE-2026-41178 (bsc#1276707): otel/baggage is 1.44.0, fixed in
    1.44.0
  * CVE-2026-63209 (bsc#1283727): klauspost/compress is 1.20.1,
    contains the fix of 1.18.7
  * CVE-2026-72924 (bsc#1276755): gh is above 2.98.0, the fixed
    version
  * CVE-2026-59831 (bsc#1271215): gh is above 2.95.0, the last
    affected version
